seams.assumed_external_interface: Plane Worker.Run(ctx, workspace, WorkOrder, stdout, stderr); Wingless SubmitWork/Status/Cancel/Result remains internal only
seams.reason: Plane owns work lifecycle while Wingless supplies bounded intelligence behind an adapter
seams.data_contract: plane work-order ID + attempt + workspace path + baseline SHA -> one bounded Wingless request -> candidate-only result
seams.authority_boundary: plane owns queue, dispatch, workspace lifecycle, retry, cancellation state and acceptance
seams.failure_semantics: identity mismatch, stale revision, unsupported state or candidate acceptance claim fails closed
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: frozen plane currently permits only fake or codex worker kinds, so live activation requires an explicit plane contract change
seams.reconciliation_action: retain inactive translation adapter and add plane-side wingless worker kind only in a separately authorized stage
seams.translation: Plane Worker.Run is synchronous and receives the plane-owned workspace plus WorkOrder. Wingless in-memory lifecycle is never projected onto plane state.
seams.activation_blocker: Frozen plane WorkOrder.Validate accepts only fake or codex worker kinds; no wingless worker kind exists.

seams.assumed_external_interface: trusted Wingless route policy and backend allowlist
seams.reason: model selection remains local intelligence policy without acquiring plane authority
seams.expected_plane_point: inside the future wingless worker implementation
seams.data_contract: trusted allowed backends, deep/fallback authorization and reason; Repairs=0 and MaxRepairs=0 for plane-driven work
seams.authority_boundary: plane owns work-order retry and reconciliation; Wingless owns only inference routing
seams.failure_semantics: no authorized healthy capable backend returns operator_blocked without plane retry
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: allowing Wingless repair attempts would duplicate plane retry ownership
seams.reconciliation_action: force zero local repair budget for all plane-driven requests
seams.translation: Backend routing is local intelligence policy; plane work-order retry/reconciliation remains external.

seams.reason: vendor-neutral bounded generation belongs to Wingless
seams.expected_plane_point: candidate generation within future wingless worker
seams.data_contract: bounded request with parent work ID, deterministic request ID, workspace identity, deadline, capabilities and resource policy
seams.authority_boundary: inference output is candidate-only and cannot grant acceptance
seams.failure_semantics: timeout, cancellation, backend failure or noncompleted result remains non-authoritative
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: text output may later need an artifact translation without changing acceptance ownership
seams.reconciliation_action: keep candidate projection external_required and reject any Wingless acceptance claim
seams.translation: Inference output is candidate-only; adapter requires external_required acceptance.

seams.reason: Wingless needs local admission checks for model inference
seams.expected_plane_point: pre-inference admission inside future wingless worker
seams.data_contract: nullable RAM, VRAM, disk and CPU measurements checked against trusted floors/ceiling
seams.authority_boundary: measurement/admission is not a plane allocation lease or scheduling grant
seams.failure_semantics: missing required metric, provider error or floor/ceiling violation denies inference
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: future plane resource reservation semantics could conflict if treated as equivalent
seams.reconciliation_action: preserve Wingless resource admission as local measurement only until a plane allocation contract exists
seams.translation: Frozen plane has toolchain/execution preflight but no RAM/VRAM/GPU allocation lease contract.

seams.reason: Wingless owns bounded source-context retrieval while plane owns workspace identity
seams.data_contract: query + byte budget over ICE rooted to the exact authorized workspace/revision
seams.authority_boundary: ICE is advisory and cannot override source, workspace or baseline identity
seams.failure_semantics: stale revision, workspace mismatch, invalid range or over-budget context fails closed
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: using stale ICE against a rematerialized workspace could produce invalid reasoning
seams.reconciliation_action: bind work-order ID, workspace path and baseline SHA before context retrieval
seams.translation: ICE remains advisory; stale workspace revision fails closed.

seams.reason: models must never acquire generic shell or write/process authority
seams.data_contract: Wingless bounded reads; future write/process request must be explicitly translated into plane-authorized operations
seams.authority_boundary: plane work-order scope and isolated workspace control writes and process execution
seams.failure_semantics: unsupported write/process authority is rejected rather than executed locally
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: a generic Wingless shell would bypass plane scope, evidence and acceptance boundaries
seams.reconciliation_action: retain bounded reads and defer writes/processes to a future explicit plane executor contract
seams.translation: Future writes/processes require explicit plane authorization; Wingless does not gain shell authority.

seams.reason: fixture verification remains useful for research but cannot become plane acceptance
seams.expected_plane_point: none for work-order retry or acceptance
seams.data_contract: offline fixture verdict only; plane-driven adapter sets local repair budget to zero
seams.authority_boundary: plane owns retry count, retry scheduling, deterministic acceptance and terminal work state
seams.failure_semantics: fixture failure blocks local candidate generation and never schedules a work-order retry
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: local repair loops would duplicate controller-owned retry/reconciliation
seams.reconciliation_action: keep verifier internal/offline and prohibit repairs for plane-driven work
seams.translation: Fixture verifier cannot drive plane retry or acceptance.

seams.reason: model process state is distinct from plane work-order lifecycle
seams.expected_plane_point: health of future wingless worker backend
seams.data_contract: STOPPED, STARTING, READY, BUSY, IDLE, DRAINING, FAILED, UNAVAILABLE
seams.authority_boundary: Wingless lifecycle cannot mutate plane queue/work-order lifecycle
seams.failure_semantics: invalid local transition is rejected and backend unavailability blocks inference
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: conflating inference health with plane work state could corrupt controller ownership
seams.reconciliation_action: expose health only; never translate local lifecycle into authoritative plane state mutations

seams.reason: model quality/resource experiments are Wingless research concerns
seams.expected_plane_point: none; evidence may inform future backend policy only
seams.data_contract: fixture prompt/expected result plus route, latency and resource evidence
seams.authority_boundary: benchmark verdicts never map to plane acceptance
seams.failure_semantics: unsupported or failed experiment reports unavailable/failure without changing plane state
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: research scores could be misread as production acceptance
seams.translation: Benchmark verdicts remain research evidence only.

seams.reason: Wingless owns experimental inference process behavior until plane explicitly adopts a worker contract
seams.data_contract: pinned executable/model, bounded startup/runtime configuration and process evidence
seams.authority_boundary: no model-proposed execution and no live plane authority
seams.failure_semantics: startup/runtime failure stops the owned child; no automatic plane retry
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: competing process-lifetime owners could cause unsafe cancellation/restart behavior
seams.reconciliation_action: keep modelhost independent until one explicit lifetime owner is established in plane integration
seams.translation: Independent model supervision remains Wingless-owned pending explicit plane worker integration.

seams.module: stage3 internal telemetry and output contracts
seams.assumed_external_interface: GPUProvider, ProcessProbe and OutputConstraint internal contracts
seams.reason: telemetry and output constraints support inference quality/resource evidence
seams.expected_plane_point: candidate metadata only unless a future explicit contract is added
seams.data_contract: nullable hardware/process samples and bounded output constraint metadata
seams.authority_boundary: no resource lease, shell authority or acceptance grant is implied
seams.failure_semantics: missing required telemetry or unsupported constraint fails closed/unavailable
seams.risk_if_plane_differs: metadata could be mistaken for a scheduler reservation or acceptance signal
seams.reconciliation_action: keep telemetry/output constraints internal and non-authoritative
seams.translation: Telemetry/output constraints are candidate metadata only.
